title: Telemetry
description: One instrument reading. Every field marked required is required because an accessibility channel depends on it. Schema lint fails the build on omission.

id.description: Namespaced identifier, e.g. core:drive.thrust. Namespace is core: for first-party. Never rapidity:.

label.description: Full human-readable name. Screen reader and tooltip.

shortLabel.description: Abbreviated form for MFD real estate and braille displays.

value.description: SI value, always. Never pre-converted for display.

formatted.description: Display string in player-facing units. Never contains gamma or rapidity.

spoken.description: Screen reader form. Expands symbols and units into words. Not the same as `formatted`.
examples: earth clock three point two six times

quality.description: stale is set while causally disconnected (warp). Only caution and warning auto-announce.

band.description: Normal operating range, rendered as a bar so deviation reads before the number.

group.description: Query group. Screen reader hotkeys poll a whole group.

sonify.description: Optional audio mapping. Never the sole channel for anything actionable.
